scientific_question: Can a compact fixed-connectivity global Givens flow realize enough of the 85.72% right-orthogonal c_proj orbit to justify production training?

candidate.action: post-GELU hidden-frame transport folded into the materialized c_proj weight
candidate.connectivity: independently fixed random perfect matching at each stage
candidate.learned_values: one angle per matched channel pair

pilot.metric: phase-chord endpoint recovery and fraction of the exact right-orthogonal oracle

decision_rule.promote: smallest stage count with energy-weighted recovery >=0.20 and minimum-cell recovery >=0.10
decision_rule.all_cell_validation: required after pilot promotion and before implementation in the training model
decision_rule.reject: if 32 stages fail the pilot threshold, close shallow fixed-connectivity Givens transport; the dense right-orbit upper bound then requires a richer structured factorization

execution: direct foreground analysis on Y400 GPU1; no training, MFU gate, queue, watchdog, callback, heartbeat, or PRO6
